authority: experiment-owner direction to continue replicate work without per-run confirmation
finding: Since 2026-09-24T14:08Z no OpenCode lane has completed. Three consecutive attempts across both fixtures, including two bare-control lanes with no treatment installed, timed out on task-01 inside the 7200s per-task budget. None carries a single provider error.

timeline.window: Degradation began within three minutes of the last successful lane finishing and has persisted for about ten hours.

diagnosis.not_quota: Zero AI_APICallError and zero usage-limit text in every one of the three lanes. The quota aborts of 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-23 each carried thirteen such entries, so this is a different failure.
diagnosis.not_credentials: The access token is valid to 2026-09-28 and a minimal paid probe on 2026-09-24 completed normally.
diagnosis.not_treatment_specific: Two of the three failures are bare-control lanes with no product installed. The third is a plugin treatment. The failure does not depend on what is being measured.
diagnosis.not_fixture_specific: Two failures on Fastify, one on Beets. Beets had been completing normally as recently as 08:42 the same day.
diagnosis.what_it_looks_like: Provider throughput collapsed to roughly five to twenty minutes per agent step, against a normal rate that completes 118 to 145 steps within six task budgets. OpenCode streams, receives, and advances its loop without error; it is simply far too slow to finish a task.

spend.note: Real but unquantifiable across all three lanes. Provider streams were issued in each, but the adapter writes normalized events at task completion and every kill left a zero-byte event file, so no step_finish telemetry survives to sum. Disclosed as unmeasurable rather than as zero.

decision.halt: Stop launching OpenCode lanes until a cheap probe shows throughput has recovered.
decision.reasoning: The apparatus cannot currently produce a measurement. Each further attempt costs about two hours and an unquantifiable spend for an outcome that is now predictable. Continuing would convert budget into receipts rather than results.
decision.explicitly_not_done: Raising the per-task timeout would let these lanes finish, but timeout_seconds_per_task is part of the execution descriptor, so it mints a protocol identity differing from the control's. Treatments measured under a longer budget than their control are not like-for-like, and the fix for a slow environment is not a changed apparatus.
decision.resume_condition: Re-probe throughput before relaunching. A bare control lane completing within budget is the signal; a minimal paid probe confirms only that the provider answers, not that it answers fast enough.

open_questions_left_by_the_halt.fastify_control: Stays at three replicates with a 23.6% spread that widened rather than converged. Every single-replicate Fastify delta in the arm inherits that uncertainty, including the two headline savings.
open_questions_left_by_the_halt.ponytail_fastify: Its -20.7% reading, marginal against control noise, is still unreplicated.
open_questions_left_by_the_halt.tokenjuice_fastify: Its -52.0% reading, the second largest in the arm, is still unreplicated.

revision_20260926.supersedes: the blanket reading that the environment cannot produce measurements
revision_20260926.finding: The degradation is intermittent, not continuous. Successes and failures now interleave within hours of each other.
sequence: 2026-09-24T14:11Z fastify control r5 - failed at step 12
2026-09-24T22:24Z fastify control r5 retry - failed at step 4
2026-09-25T00:26Z beets ponytail r3 - failed at step 11
2026-09-26 fastify control r5 third attempt - SUCCEEDED, 142 steps, 6/6
2026-09-26T00:46Z beets ponytail r3 retry - failed at step 5
revision_20260926.consequence: A single failed lane no longer justifies halting, and a single successful probe no longer certifies the environment. Throughput varies enough between adjacent runs that neither a success nor a failure generalises to the next launch.
revision_20260926.what_this_costs: Roughly two hours and an unquantifiable spend per failed attempt, with no way to predict which attempts will land. Ponytail r3 on Beets has now failed twice while the control succeeded between them.
revision_20260926.method_change: Rather than retry the same cell a third time, the next launch moves to a different treatment. If it lands, the failures are cell-independent bad luck and Ponytail can be retried later; if it also fails, the environment is unusable again and the halt resumes. That is a cheaper discriminator than repeating one cell.
revision_20260926.spend: Unquantifiable, as before. The kill leaves a zero-byte event file and no step_finish telemetry survives.

halt_resumed_20260926.trigger: The discriminator launched under revision_20260926 failed. TokenJuice r3 on Beets reached step 1 in the 7200s budget, with zero errors and zero quota entries.
halt_resumed_20260926.reading: Two different treatments on the same lane both failed, and throughput is degrading across attempts: ponytail reached step 11, then step 5, then tokenjuice step 1. The one success in this window, the Fastify control at 142 steps, now looks like the exception rather than evidence of recovery.
halt_resumed_20260926.decision: Halt resumed, per the rule recorded in revision_20260926. No further OpenCode lanes until a bare control completes within budget.
halt_resumed_20260926.cumulative_cost_of_the_window: Five lanes at roughly two hours each, every one disclosed as unquantifiable spend because the kill leaves a zero-byte event file with no step_finish telemetry to sum.
halt_resumed_20260926.what_is_not_being_done: Raising the per-task timeout would let these lanes finish but mints a protocol identity differing from the control's, so treatments would no longer be measured under the same budget as the control they are compared against. The environment is the problem and changing the apparatus to accommodate it would put the defect into the measurement.
halt_resumed_20260926.resume_condition: A bare control lane completing within budget. A minimal paid probe is explicitly insufficient: one returned in six seconds on 2026-09-26 and the lane launched immediately after it still failed.
